Tata's Battery Unit Uses In-House Technology Amid Global Supply Chain Shifts

Tata's battery unit is reportedly turning to its own technology for manufacturing lithium cells. This development comes as China tightens export curbs on such components. The move by Tata Group aims to leverage in-house expertise for battery production. This is happening in the context of global supply chain dynamics and India's push for renewable energy growth, which requires significant battery storage and transmission expansion.
